own_short_summary: V-REx penalizes disagreement in source-domain predictive risks. The paper reports comparable ERM performance on DomainBed and sensitivity to irreducible risk differences; neither universal gains nor a causal guarantee for finite-domain deep networks follows. This motivates an empirical fixed transfer, not abstract rejection or an innovation claim.
transfer_difference: Primary paper equation8 displays a risk sum; pinned DomainBed implements a domain mean. Native UWB uses onehot12 BCE and AdamWLookahead, not a literal reproduction of the original image recipe. Equal-domain weighting and a full optimizer reset need registered controls before attributing a gain to variance.
